title: tomophyllum hayatae
intro: Tomophyllum hayatae, commonly known as the Hayata's fern or silverback fern, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of epiphytic fern native to Taiwan and Japan. The plant has been found to have potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. Bioactive constituents of Tomophyllum hayatae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and antidiabetic effects.
